config.command.description: Runtime launcher when dsh.serverUrl is empty. Default auto prefers a compatible local dsh on PATH or in the npm global prefix. Incompatible local CLIs offer an upgrade first; declining falls back to pinned pnpm/npx, then the managed Runtime. Verified older npm global installs upgrade only with approval. Explicit pnpm/npx keeps package-manager startup.
config.commandArgs.description: Runtime arguments; default web --no-open. Without a saved override, explicit pnpm/npx automatically receives the appropriate dlx/package prefix. In auto mode, legacy package-manager prefixes are omitted for a local CLI and retained for package-manager fallback. A --port argument is appended if absent. Bare @deepseek-ai/dsh is pinned to this extension's supported version; explicitly pinned versions must also pass compatibility checks.
config.npxTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for npx or pnpm to download the DSH package and start its web server. If the attempt looks like a package-manager download failure, an alternate registry is tried once.
config.npmRegistry.description: Alternate npm-compatible registry used once after an npx or pnpm download/start failure. The default is npmmirror; if the active package manager is already using it, the official registry is tried instead. Leave empty to disable the fallback.
config.enableCompaction.description: Enable the official /compact command when the extension starts its own DSH web server.
config.jev.enabled.description: Enable the built-in Jev integration. Guarded-tool arguments and any explicitly enabled policy samples are sent to the configured TypeSafe endpoint; review the privacy notice before enabling, configure the key with DSH: Configure Jev API Key, and restart the Runtime after changing this setting.
config.jev.baseUrl.description: TypeSafe System One endpoint used by the built-in Jev integration. Use HTTPS for non-local endpoints.
config.jev.model.description: Jev model name sent to the configured System One endpoint.
config.jev.timeoutMs.description: Overall Jev request timeout in milliseconds.
config.jev.advisoryTimeoutMs.description: Bounded Jev safety-advisory timeout in milliseconds; transient failures receive one retry.
config.jev.askThreshold.description: Probability threshold at which Jev asks the DSH tool pipeline for confirmation.
config.jev.blockThreshold.description: Probability threshold at which Jev denies a guarded tool call.
config.jev.guardedTools.description: Tool names whose complete arguments are sent to Jev when the integration is enabled.
config.jev.loopGuard.enabled.description: Enable Jev's semantic loop guard after tool execution. It may send recent tool output and trajectory samples to Jev.
config.jev.loopGuard.triggerThreshold.de: Number of recent executions required before the loop guard asks Jev for a stagnation verdict.
config.jev.loopGuard.noProgressThreshold: Minimum Jev progress probability that counts as meaningful progress.
config.jev.loopGuard.pLoopThreshold.desc: Minimum Jev dead-loop probability required before the loop guard warns or interrupts.
config.jev.loopGuard.minConfidence.descr: Minimum Jev confidence required before the loop guard acts on a verdict.
config.jev.loopGuard.cooldownSteps.descr: Number of later tool executions to skip after a loop-guard warning or interruption.
config.jev.loopGuard.maxHistory.descript: Maximum recent tool executions retained for loop-guard analysis.
config.jev.loopGuard.deferExactRepeats.d: Leave exact duplicate tool calls to DSH's built-in repeat reminder instead of sending them to Jev.
config.jev.loopGuard.requestTimeoutMs.de: Maximum Jev request time for one loop-guard analysis.
config.jev.loopGuard.include.description: Optional tool allowlist for loop-guard analysis; an empty list includes all tools.
config.jev.loopGuard.exclude.description: Tool names excluded from loop-guard analysis.
config.jev.resultShaper.enabled.descript: Enable Jev's post-execute result shaper. Repetitive large tool output may be replaced before the next model turn.
config.jev.resultShaper.shapeTools.descr: Tool names whose repetitive large text results may be shaped.
config.jev.resultShaper.thresholdChars.d: Minimum result size in characters before result shaping is considered.
config.jev.resultShaper.maxPerTurn.descr: Maximum number of results the shaper may change in one agent turn.
config.jev.resultShaper.keepKinds.descri: Output classifications that the shaper must retain, such as warning and failure.
config.jev.resultShaper.minKindConfidenc: Minimum Jev confidence required to keep a classified output group.
config.jev.resultShaper.maxClusters.desc: Maximum distinct output line groups sent to Jev for classification.
config.jev.resultShaper.sampleChars.desc: Maximum sample characters sent for each output line group.
config.jev.resultShaper.requestTimeoutMs: Maximum Jev request time for one result-shaper analysis.
config.jev.doneGate.enabled.description: Enable Jev's completion evidence gate. It can ask the agent to verify work before claiming completion and may add a turn.
config.jev.doneGate.blockThreshold.descr: Completion and evidence probability threshold at which the evidence gate requests verification.
config.jev.doneGate.minEvidenceItems.des: Minimum successful tool-evidence items required to accept a completion claim.
config.jev.doneGate.requestTimeoutMs.des: Maximum Jev request time for one completion-evidence check.
config.jev.doneGate.maxClaimChars.descri: Maximum assistant completion-claim characters sent to Jev.
config.jev.doneGate.cooldownTurns.descri: Number of later turns to skip after one completion-evidence intervention.
config.autonomousDebugging.description: Let the agent drive this window's debugger through a loopback MCP endpoint: start an existing launch configuration, set breakpoints, step, and read the paused stack. Only applies to a DSH Runtime this window starts, and takes effect after the Runtime is restarted.
config.serverUrl.description: Optional HTTP(S) URL for an already running, trusted dsh web 0.1.5-rc.1 runtime. When set, the extension attaches to it instead of spawning dsh.command. Loopback HTTP is allowed; remote runtimes must use HTTPS. Provide its launch token either in the URL or through dsh.serverToken.
config.serverToken.description: Optional dsh web launch token for dsh.serverUrl. Use this when the Runtime address and token are configured separately; the token is exchanged for an authenticated session and is not sent as an Authorization header.
config.serverPort.description: Port passed to dsh web when dsh.serverUrl is empty and dsh.commandArgs has no port. With zero, a healthy version-compatible Runtime recorded in the shared lock is reused first; otherwise port 3080 is probed, used when free, and replaced with an OS-assigned port when occupied by a non-DSH service or when the probe is uncertain. A recognizable untracked DSH listener on 3080 is never duplicated.
config.autoStart.description: Start or attach to dsh web automatically when the extension activates. If false, start it from the status label or with DSH: Start dsh Web Runtime.
config.recovery.enabled.description: Automatically diagnose and recover local DSH startup failures in an isolated sandbox.
config.recovery.autoPersistBundleIsolati: Persist a high-confidence profile bundle isolation after sandbox verification.
config.installWhenMissing.description: When dsh, pnpm, npm and npx are all unavailable, download a standalone DSH Runtime from the pinned release source and manage it locally. Other custom commands are never replaced.
config.runtimeVersion.description: Target version for approved local CLI upgrades and plugin Runtime downloads. Defaults to 0.1.5-rc.2; any valid SemVer at or above the minimum 0.1.5-rc.1 is accepted. Already compatible local CLIs are reused. Unsupported values are rejected before discovery or downloads.
config.startupTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the dsh web HTTP health check after starting or attaching.
config.requestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time for one Harness RPC, including reconnect history rebaselines. Live assistant output is delivered over WebSocket and is not polled.
config.maxContextBytes.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes of the assembled <ide_context> block included in one prompt.
config.terminalHistorySize.description: Number of recent shell commands kept in memory per terminal. Only commands reported by VS Code Shell Integration after extension activation are captured; terminal output is never persisted.
config.persistSession.description: Reuse the last dsh session ID for the current workspace when possible. Chat messages and attached context are not persisted.
config.apiKeyEnv.description: Credential reference passed to dsh.credentials.set when using DSH: Configure API Key. The key is also encrypted in VS Code SecretStorage when balance display is enabled.
config.agentStatusLabel.description: Optional fixed text shown while DSH is streaming an assistant response. Leave empty to randomly choose an item from dsh.agentStatusLabels. A companion extension can temporarily override either setting through the exported API.
config.agentStatusLabels.description: Candidate labels randomly selected once per streaming agent turn when dsh.agentStatusLabel is empty.
config.balanceRefreshIntervalMs.descript: Interval for refreshing the DeepSeek balance status bar item.
config.enableEffortKnob.description: Show the chibi runner sprite as the reasoning effort slider knob. Disable to use the native slider handle.
config.autoOpenReasoning.description: Automatically expand the reasoning fold while it is streaming in and collapse it when streaming completes. Manual toggles between those transitions are respected; history messages stay collapsed.
